exposure: Gestational age at birth (early term vs. full term)
outcome: Admission to neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
Need for IV fluid treatment support
cohort: 300 pregnant women who gave birth at a tertiary hospital between January 1, 2019 and January 1, 2021.
finding: There was no significant difference in NICU admission rates between vaginal and cesarean deliveries for term, low-risk pregnancies, but early term delivery was associated with higher rates of neonatal morbidity and NICU admission.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery affects hospitalization indications of newborns, need for support, and Apgar scores.
